say.speaker: machop
say.text: Hold it right there, {name:lord}! Before we break camp, let me test the knots on your supply pack.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Everything is buckled down, {name:machop}. Did a strap come loose?

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Nope, nice and tight. Now squeeze my forearm as hard as you can! Come on, full grip!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Wait, why? Alright... there. Happy?

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Hup! Solid clamp, decent wrist lock! Boss Machamp always says half of winning a mountain fight happens in the fingers before a single punch lands.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Tonight after dinner, I am running cliff-ledge finger hangs with pebbles in my belt. You are welcome to join my drill!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Leave out the extra pebbles for night one, {name:machop}, and you have a deal.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Still out here, {name:machop}? Everyone else turned in an hour ago, and your knuckles look scraped raw.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Gah! Just twenty more fingertip presses against this boulder, {name:lord}. My left hand slipped on the wet slate earlier.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Boss Machamp cleared an entire ridge rockslide by himself this week. Meanwhile, I led your squad straight into cave ambushes and needed bailing out on my own shortcut.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Wait a second. Nobody asked you to move a whole mountain solo, {name:machop}. Your tunnel got us past the blockade before dusk.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Sure, after we had to fight our way through! When Boss Machamp told me to step in for him, I swore I would not look like a kid playing guide.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: You took point in dark stone against wild packs and never missed a footing once. Wrap those hands before you tear a tendon, or tomorrow's march is going to hurt.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Heh... alright, captain. One wrap of cloth, then straight to bed. Thanks, {name:lord}.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Last handhold right there, {name:lord}! Pull up onto the shelf and catch the sunrise!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Whoa... You can see the whole mountain pass behind us and the plains stretching straight out ahead.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: Funny, isn't it? Your footwork barely even kicked a pebble loose on that chimney climb. All those drills paid off.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Only because you spotted every solid crack in the granite first, {name:machop}.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: I sent a courier slate back to Boss Machamp yesterday. Didn't claim I out-lifted him or cleared a pass alone, either.

say.speaker: machop
say.text: I wrote that I found a leader worth climbing beside! Whenever this Rift mess is finished, {name:lord}, you have a permanent rope partner on the high peaks.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Count on it, {name:machop}. Just promise we climb down before breakfast cools off.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Hey, {name:slakoth}, your watch turn starts in five minutes. Can you let go of the berry crate long enough to sit up?

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: *Yaaawn*... Morning already? Give me two more blinks, {name:lord}. The shade on this crate is top grade.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: If you fall asleep on sentry duty, a whole pack could waltz right past the lantern.

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Mm... Not a pack. Just one wild Zigzagoon sniffing the fern patch twenty paces northwest. Wind shifted left.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Hold on... Wait, there really is a tail poking out of the ferns northwest! Your eyes weren't even open!

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Ears don't need eyelids, {name:lord}. Toss me a spare Oran Berry from that crate and I'll listen for anything bigger.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Mind if I sit by this oak for noon rest, {name:slakoth}? Everyone else is sparring by the creek.

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: *Yaaawn*... Plenty of moss to share, {name:lord}. Here, take the sunny half of this Oran Berry.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Thanks. Hey, before we found you in Lush Prairie, how did you dodge poachers on your own while napping in broad daylight?

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Easy. Crickets go quiet before boots hit the hill. Clover bends the wrong way when an ambush stalks downwind. Even dirt hums before heavy hooves charge.

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Moving fast all day burns out your nerves. Save everything for the one swing that counts, and the noise stops bothering you.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: No wonder your hits land like falling timber once you finally wake up, {name:slakoth}.

say.speaker: slakoth
say.text: Lean against my shoulder and shut your eyes for ten minutes, {name:lord}. I will nudge you if the crickets stop singing.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Heads up below, {name:lord}! Clear road for two miles, zero bandits, and three shortcut bends marked on the ridge!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Fast report as ever, {name:starly}. Did you even touch a branch the whole flight?

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Please! I fly twice as fast now as I did back on the hometown pitch. Speaking of which, your left flank only held in our sparring bout because I hit a nasty crosswind!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: A crosswind? On a calm evening in town? That is a bold rewrite of history, {name:starly}.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Hey, gusts happen! Tell you what, next time the vanguard spots a fork in the trail, bet I tag the high signpost before your boots clear the grass!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: You are on, {name:starly}. Just remember to actually report what is past the signpost when you win.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Done deal! Watch my tail feathers eat the dust, {name:lord}!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: {name:starly}, come down by the tent awning. You have been shaking rain out of your wings on that wet pine bough for twenty minutes.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: I am fine, {name:lord}! Just keeping high lookout in case this storm blows something ugly off the ridge.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Here, dry towel near the brazier. When you three trailed us over the mountain pass to reach the capital, did you fly through gales like this alone?

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Tch... Up above the passes, the sleet nearly pinned my wings shut twice. Lost your tracks in the fog for half a day.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: You left town on a royal summons without saying a word! Somebody had to catch up fast before your squad walked straight under an ambush!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: I should have told you at the gate, {name:starly}. I didn't want to drag home friends into real blades.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Too late for that now, rival. Scold me in the morning; tonight I am hogging the warm corner by your fire.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Quiet evening, {name:starly}. Usually you are buzzing circles around camp until lights out.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Look up at that clear sky, {name:lord}. Hard to believe it cracked open like glass outside the Emerald Capital just days ago.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: When Great Tusk roared out of that Rift, the updraft shook every feather off balance. Up in open air, there is nothing to brace against if the sky itself breaks.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Then you drop straight down to our line whenever it does, {name:starly}. You watch the horizon from above, and I will hold every shadow on the ground beneath you.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Heh... Not bad for somebody who still cannot fly a single yard.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Truth is, you are the only rival whose pace I would ever slow my wings down to match, {name:lord}. Knowing you are anchored below makes every dive worth taking.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Same here, {name:starly}. Nobody leads the squad into battle sharper than you.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Hey, {name:lord}. Before the horns blow for the next march, catch!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Wait, is this one of your primary feathers? You braided green grass cord right around the quill.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Yeah, well, do not make a speech about it! Back home, flyers trade a shed pinion when they swear to share the same sky for life.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Give me a moment... There, knotted straight onto my expedition badge where everybody can see it.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Listen to me, {name:lord}. I do not care if this road drags us through frozen peaks, desert wastes, or straight into the Rift itself.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Every battle from here until the world is quiet again, my shadow flies right above your shoulder. No rival, no storm, and no distance breaks this flock.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Sworn partners from the hometown pitch to the end of the map, {name:starly}. Wherever you fly, I am right beneath you.

say.speaker: starly
say.text: Good! Now try keeping up when I sound the advance, partner!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: What are you sketching in the dirt over there, {name:caterpie}?

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Oh, {name:lord}! Look at these giant fern fronds along the capital road. Each leaflet is wider than our whole clover patch back home!

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Every mile we walk out here, the bark smells different and the canopy climbs twice as high. I keep wondering what the view looks like from those top branches.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Hold steady a second, {name:caterpie}. Hop onto my arm and let us reach that high cedar bough over the ridge.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Whoa! Look at the valley mist curling between the spires! Everything down on the road looks tiny from up here!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Wait till we reach the other kingdoms, {name:caterpie}. I bet there are treetops twice as tall waiting for you.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Then I am going to count every single leaf along the way, {name:lord}!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Hey, {name:caterpie}, did you tie these silver silk threads between the wagon wheels and the supply sacks?

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Ah, you noticed! Sorry if they look messy, {name:lord}. The slope behind camp gets slick with dew at night, and the heavy crates kept shifting toward the ditch.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: I cannot haul boulders like Quaquaval or punch through stone walls like the big fighters, so I figured anchoring the packs was the least I could handle.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Messy? You saved half our spare remedies from tumbling down a ravine in the dark, {name:caterpie}.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Besides, nobody catches loose latches or hidden snares down near the grass faster than you. Our hometown crew would be lost without your eyes.

say.speaker: caterpie
say.text: Really? Then tonight I will weave extra guide lines up the steep switchback before sunrise so nobody slips!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Lead the way up the ridge, {name:caterpie}. Just save some energy for spotting the next high branch!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Up and at 'em, {name:lord}! Three, two, one, rematch time right here by the cookfire!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Hold on, {name:pawmi}! I barely finished pouring hot tea, and your cheeks are already sparking like firecrackers!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: That is because I have been waiting since the hometown pitch bout! You three broke my Nuzzle lock with Paralyze Heal and swept the field. That score is staying zero to one until I tag you back!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Haha, careful! One more bounce like that and you are going to toast the kettle.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Whoa, zap! Good catch, sorry, kettle! Okay, five minutes after packs are rolled. Three quick rounds of footwork, full speed!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Three rounds, no Nuzzle shocks near the tents. Deal, {name:pawmi}!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Deal! Better stretch those legs fast, {name:lord}, because I am not slowing down!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Hey, {name:pawmi}. You have been scrubbing soot off your gloves all alone by the stream since the skirmish ended.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Oh, hey, {name:lord}. Look at my cheeks. Every time I try charging up tonight, the sparks just fizzle sideways.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Back on the town pitch, yelling and snapping jolts felt like a huge game. Today, charging down real horns and iron hides, I wondered if a little shock from me could even stop anybody from getting hurt.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Wait a minute. Who sprinted right into the middle of a stampede outside the capital gates without hesitating half a heartbeat?

say.speaker: lord
say.text: One spark from you locks up an attacker mid-charge and buys the whole line room to breathe, {name:pawmi}. I never doubt who has my flank when I hear that crackle.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Pop! Heh... hear that? Guess the static came right back on its own.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Thanks, {name:lord}. Next time a heavy charger rushes the line, I am meeting them head-on before they touch you!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Step left, pivot, fake right! Come on, {name:lord}, match the count!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Right behind your shoulder, {name:pawmi}! Watch the inside lane, cut back!

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Whoa, hold up! You shifted left half a second before my heel even planted!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: After how many bouts together since town, {name:pawmi}? I can tell which way you are cutting just from the flicker on your whiskers.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Hahaha! Remember when we used to clash head-first across the grass just trying to outscore each other?

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Fighting on the same side of the line feels ten times faster. Nobody else in the whole squad can keep up with our tempo, {name:lord}!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Then let us run the drill one more time before dark, partner. Same count!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Taking the late watch under the stars, {name:pawmi}? No midnight sprints tonight?

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Not tonight, {name:lord}. Sit here for a minute. Look, my cheeks are just humming warm and steady, no wild crackles at all.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Back home, I chased you across the pitch every day just to prove I was faster. Then we crossed the mountains, stared down that torn sky, and everything clicked.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: I wasn't chasing a rematch anymore, {name:lord}. I just couldn't stand the thought of you walking into the dark ahead of us without me at your side.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: That goes both ways, {name:pawmi}. Every time the odds look impossible, hearing your cheer makes the whole field feel winnable.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: No matter how far the Rift pulls us from home, we see this through together and run the victory lap back to our old pitch side by side.

say.speaker: pawmi
say.text: Sworn partners for life, {name:lord}! From the hometown grass to the end of the war, my spark stays locked right next to yours!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Unbroken current, {name:pawmi}. Always.
